form:FormGroup.label: Range Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data type used to store the start and end of each range: unsigned Byte, Short, Integer or Long. Choose the smallest type that holds your largest value. Default is Unsigned Long.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Smallest unsigned type that holds your largest value. Default is Unsigned Long.

form:FormGroup.label: Temporal Precision
form:FormGroup.helpText: How precisely the time of each entry is stored, from Day down to Nanosecond. Coarser precision uses less space. Default is Millisecond.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: From Day to Nanosecond; coarser uses less space. Default is Millisecond.
